Method of Attack: Brute-force attack exploiting weak entropy in SecureRandom() generated keys, including use of obsolete RC4 algorithm reducing entropy
Discoverer: Anonymous user on Linux Foundation mailing list
Impacted Systems: Bitcoin addresses generated using BitAddress client-side wallet pre-2013
Bitcoin addresses generated using Bitcoinjs pre-2014
Wallet apps using pre-2013 versions of jsbn.js cryptographic library
Attack Vector: JavaScript SecureRandom() function in browser or client-side wallet apps
Use of vulnerable cryptographic library versions in wallet apps
